ships roughly 511 GB of weights. That is the number your GPUs must hold. The default production shape is one 8x H200 node (AWS p5en, Azure ND H200 v5, GCP a3-ultragpu-8g). With the Engram tables moved to host RAM, vLLM runs one replica on 4x H200, so one node serves two replicas. KV cache is almost a rounding error on this model. DeepSeek reports 890 bytes per token, so 50 concurrent 128k-token sessions add under 6 GB. Keep tensor parallelism inside one node on NVLink. Only span nodes over EFA or InfiniBand.

552B backbone parameters plus 196B Engram memory parameters. The model activates 16B per token during decode and 8B during prefill ( DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash technical report ).
